{{Conjecture}}
[[Danta Belissa]], a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and souvenir [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] operating on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] level 120, owned a small '''souvenir and antique shop''' just about the seedy [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]]. The shop's adjacent restaurant served spicy [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] food for the administrative personnel who worked on the level. The restaurant was tucked away in a remote corner, but near the nexus of many breezeways so the scent of food carried many meters. Dishes at the restaurant included roast [[kelbird]] and fried [[dinnd]]. While Belissa's wife and daughter did most of the cooking, he ran the souvenir and antique shop nearby, which employed five full time workers since<ref name="GG3-2">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
